references.text: God instructs Moses to build the tabernacle exactly according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
Moses is told to make everything according to the pattern that was shown to him on Mount Sinai.
The altar was also to be built according to the pattern shown to Moses on the mountain.
Moses receives the command to set up the tabernacle, fulfilling the instructions given on the mountain.
Describes the actual setting up of the tabernacle in accordance with God's instructions.
The lampstand was made according to the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
Stephen refers to the tent of testimony that was built according to the pattern Moses had seen.
The author of Hebrews quotes that Moses was warned to make everything according to the pattern shown on the mountain.
